text: Long coffee with Chloe. She's finally moved to Leeds, renting near the station, and works at the uni library now. Her brother Owen is still in Dublin doing something in fintech. Their mum's retired to Spain. Chloe's cycling to work every day and loves it. She said Owen might move back next year if the Dublin rents keep climbing, and that their mum keeps nagging them both to visit her in Malaga.

Isabel's knee op is Thursday at 8am. Her husband Kofi is driving her in and staying over. She's dreading the anaesthetic more than the surgery. Text her the next day to see how it went. Kofi sounded more stressed than she did, to be honest. Physio starts a week after, and she's off work till the new year.

Caught Jun at the school gate. He and his wife Fang fly to Seoul on the 3rd, overnight from Heathrow, back on the 24th. Their kids are staying with her parents in Croydon. Jun says he never sleeps on long flights.

Eamon rang. His dad had a fall last week and is in St James's, probably home Monday. Eamon's back and forth every evening and sounds shattered. I should drop round a lasagne the day before his dad comes home.
Noah works for the council in planning, lives in Hove with his partner Samir. Samir's a paramedic, nights mostly. They've got a greyhound called Biscuit.
Dentist Tuesday at 2.15, then pick up the dry cleaning afterwards.

Dawit and Asha are off to Ethiopia for three weeks in December, first time back since the wedding. Flight's the 11th at 6 in the morning, ugh. Asha's sister Yara is minding the cat. Dawit's got his brother's engagement party out there on the 20th, so they'll be busy. Asha wants to do Lalibela afterwards if they can get flights. I should ask Dawit for the photos when they're back.
Angela had her cataract done yesterday morning. All fine, wearing a pirate patch, not allowed to drive for a week. Her son Elijah is staying with her till Sunday. Ring her Saturday afternoon.
Archie mentioned he's been with the same logistics firm 12 years. Grew up in Inverness, moved down when he met Petra. Petra teaches piano from home.

Kevin's off to Vietnam with Hoang on the 18th to meet her family in Hanoi. He's nervous about the dinner with her grandparents, keeps practising phrases. Must message him the morning they land. Hoang says her dad is a retired maths teacher and very strict, which isn't helping Kevin's nerves.

Sara's hip replacement got moved again, now the 9th at half 7. She's in for three nights minimum, then physio twice a week for six weeks afterwards. Her daughter Niamh is coming over from Galway to help. Don't forget to send flowers the day after.
Reggie and his wife have split up, he's moved into a flat above the bakery on Mill Road. Seemed okay but quiet. Their son Milan stays with him weekends.
Amir's trip to Lisbon is off, his work cancelled the conference. He's going to Porto with Ibrahim instead in late November, just for the long weekend.
Quick one: Astrid works nights at the Royal Infirmary, A&E. Lives with her partner Emil in Morningside. Vegetarian, both of them.

Luis is having his gallbladder out on Friday at 3pm. His wife Kalani says he's been grumpy and not eating much. Afterwards he's off work for a fortnight. Need to ask Kalani if they want me to take the dog that weekend.
Tunde's flying out to Lagos tomorrow night for his uncle's funeral. Back the following Tuesday. His mum went out last week already.
Fatima mentioned her parents live in Bradford, her brother Ibrahim in Toronto. She herself is an architect at a small practice in Manchester, been there since 2019.
Mrs Garcia next door had her scan this morning at 10, results in a fortnight. She seemed calm. Her grandson Luis took her.
Owen and Chloe got back from Japan on Sunday. Seventeen hours door to door, both still jetlagged. Owen bought me a tiny ceramic cat. Their next trip is already booked, Iceland in March.
Note to self, book the car in for MOT before the 30th and renew passport this week. Flights to Rome on the 14th at 7.40am.

Petra's mum is in hospital with pneumonia, been there since Wednesday. Petra's going up to Aberdeen on Saturday morning and staying a week. I should check in with her midweek. Her dad Emil is ninety and struggling to manage on his own, so she's also looking at care homes while she's up there. Archie's holding the fort with the kids.
Hoang said Kevin's birthday is the 2nd. He's been on about a new hiking backpack for months, apparently a hint. Hoang's planning dinner at the Thai place that evening at 8.
Isabel went home Saturday. Kofi says she's walking with one crutch now and bored out of her mind. Pop round with magazines.

Big catch up with Niamh, Astrid and Kalani at the pub. Niamh is starting a new job at the hospice next month and is a bit wobbly about it. Astrid's off to Norway for her cousin's wedding on the 22nd, flying Friday evening, wedding the next day. Kalani's still waiting on a date for her wrist surgery, been months. Niamh's partner Dawit is doing the Snowdon walk that weekend. I need to send Niamh a good luck message the night before her first day.
Emil was saying his sister Yara moved to Berlin in the summer. Works at a bike shop. Emil reckons he'll visit at Easter.
Kofi Okafor, from the five a side, lives in Walthamstow with two kids. Wife is a GP. Quiet guy, supports Spurs.
Sara's surgery went well, out of recovery by lunchtime. Niamh rang me at 4 to say so. She'll be in till Thursday. Card for her this week.
Milan (Mil to everyone) is off to Thailand for a month with his girlfriend Asha, leaving the 5th. Long flight via Doha. He's quit his job at the gym to do it.
Chat with Angela. Her husband Samir is waiting on a heart scan, Tuesday at 11. She's worried sick, he's pretending he isn't. Elijah's driving them. Remind me to call Angela that evening.
Took the bins out, fixed the gate. Nothing else today.
Jun's mum is coming over from Shanghai for Christmas, landing the 19th at 6am. Jun and Fang are clearing out the box room for her. Their son starts nursery in January too.
Archie phoned from the ward, they're keeping him another night after the hernia op. Petra's bringing him clean clothes in the morning. He sounded fed up. Visit tomorrow after work if he's still in.
Chloe's the one who works at the library, Owen's her brother. Owen's girlfriend is called Fang, different Fang from Jun's wife. Owen and Fang live in Rathmines.
Yara's back from Peru! Machu Picchu trek done, three stone of photos. Her boyfriend Reggie got altitude sickness on day two and had to go down. She's back at work on Monday.

Long call with Eamon. His dad's home now, using a frame, district nurse comes daily at 9. Eamon's taking a week off to settle him in. His sister Astrid comes over from Belfast on the 2nd to take over. Eamon's own back is playing up from all the lifting. Asked if I could cover his Thursday shift, said yes. Should ring him Friday to see how the first week went.
Kevin's mum died last month, I only just heard from Hoang. Funeral was in Da Nang. He's back at work but not really himself. I must text him tonight.
Dr Chen moved practices, he's at the Riverside surgery now. Mondays and Thursdays.

Kalani finally got her wrist op date, the 27th at half 9. She's a bit anxious about being one-handed with the toddler. Luis is taking the week off to help. Batch cook something to take round the day before.
Ibrahim lives in Leicester with his parents still, works in IT for a bank. Plays cricket on Sundays. His sister Fatima is the architect.
Noah and Samir fly to Cape Town on Saturday at 10pm. Eleven hours overnight. Samir's taking his parents too, for his dad's 70th. Noah's never met the wider family before.
Owen's knee's still swollen three weeks after the arthroscopy. Physio says it's normal. He's off the football till January.

Coffee with Angela and Isabel. Angela is moving in with her daughter in York next spring. Isabel's son Archie got into Edinburgh for medicine. Isabel's cat Pepper is diabetic now, insulin twice a day, which Isabel finds stressful. Angela mentioned her own birthday is the 15th, she wants nothing, which means a nice scarf.
Tunde's back from Lagos. He said the funeral was huge, about 400 people. He seemed okay but tired. His uncle had a shop in Surulere for 30 years.
Packing list for Madeira: adapter, sun cream, the good book. Taxi booked for 4am on the 6th.
Fang Lee from work is going in for keyhole surgery on her shoulder, the 11th at 1pm. Off for a fortnight. She's not fussed, says she's had worse. Her husband Hoang will be around.
Heard from Astrid. The Norway wedding was gorgeous, fjord ceremony, though her flight back got cancelled and she was stuck in Bergen an extra day. Emil had to pick her up at midnight.

Luis's op was postponed, no beds. New date not given yet. Kalani's fuming. Turns out Emil had his own drama that weekend, his brother Amir broke his ankle at five a side, surgery on the Monday at noon. Emil drove him in and stayed till evening.
Elijah lives in Bristol with his wife Sara Fernández and their twins. He's a structural engineer, she's a midwife. Twins are five.
Reggie's mum has her pacemaker fitted next Wednesday morning. He's going down to Brighton the night before to take her in. Ask him how she is the week after.
Petra's back from Aberdeen. Her mum's out of hospital and home, recovering slowly. Petra's knackered but relieved. Archie cooked for her every night apparently, which she found hilarious.
Dawit called from the airport. Their flight to Addis is delayed six hours so they'll miss the connection to Gondar. Asha's trying to rebook. Message them tomorrow morning to check they got there.
Milan and his brother Kofi are doing the Camino in May. Milan's training every weekend. Kofi's knee might be a problem.
Archie's daughter Niamh had her tonsils out on Monday. Ice cream and Netflix for a week. Archie says she's milking it. Petra's taking the next day off to be home with her.
Sara Schmidt has moved to Munich, works for BMW in procurement. Her partner Kevin is German, they met at uni. They've got a dachshund called Otto.
Samir's dad's 70th in Cape Town went brilliantly, Noah sent photos. They fly home Thursday, land Friday at 7am. Samir's back on nights from Saturday. Must get Samir's dad a card, totally missed it.
Hospital appointment for my own bloods Monday at 8.30, fasting from midnight. Then straight to work.

Yara and Reggie are off to Japan in April for cherry blossom, two weeks. Reggie's worried about the altitude thing again but there's nothing high, I told him. Yara's sister Astrid might join them for the second week in Kyoto.
Isabel's follow-up with the consultant is the 4th at 10.20. Kofi's taking her. She's hoping they'll sign her off the crutch. Text Isabel that afternoon and ask what they said.

Quiet chat with Fatima. Her dad's been diagnosed with Parkinson's, they found out a fortnight ago. She's going up to Bradford every weekend now. Her brother Ibrahim is flying back from Toronto at Christmas. She's not sleeping well.

Dinner at Kalani and Luis's. Kalani's wrist is healing, cast off on the 3rd, then physio. Luis's gallbladder op finally got a new date, the 16th at 7am, first on the list, so they have to be there by six. Their neighbour Reggie is lending them his car since theirs is in the garage. Luis keeps saying he's fine but barely touched his food. I'm minding their dog Bruno that week. Should text Luis the evening before and then Kalani the next day.
